protectivewish.def: A Reverie Dawn set buff from taking heavy damage quickly: faster reloads, flinch resistance and less accurate enemies. The 4-piece bonus cures you when it ends.
protectivewish.q: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.

builtbitter.def: Stacks gained by taking damage that speed up the equipped weapon's reload until you stow it. The 4-piece Bittersweet heals you based on the stacks lost.
builtbitter.q: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed.

bladefocus.def: A sword buff from guarding briefly then landing a hit: more sword damage and lunge distance, and more energy from Combat Meditation.
bladefocus.q: While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.

exhaust.def: A debuff that lowers the damage the affected combatant deals.
exhaust.q: Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

stackemup.def: First Ascent set stacks that the 4-piece Burn 'Em Down spends for grenade energy when you throw a grenade while Transcendent.
stackemup.q: Consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant ~6% Prismatic Grenade Energy per stack

initiative.def: Dark Age set stacks; while you have them, the 4-piece Healing Initiative makes your class ability create a healing aura that scales with the stacks.
initiative.q: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura.

ceremony.def: Taken King set ritual; Orb pickups extend it, and while it lasts ability kills spawn blinding Arc moths (Lucent Swarm).
ceremony.q: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony.

unstableessence.def: A Dreambane set buff from powerful-combatant kills that adds Grenade and Melee stat; the 4-piece heals you on sustained weapon damage while you have it.
unstableessence.q: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence.
